cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Complete the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to fill the missing gaps in an account without revealing which answer matters most to you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fill in arrival, kitchen time and departure on the party report. You used to leave half an account blank until I made you go through it in order.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why do you care when I went into the kitchen?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you're checking the questions now. But answer all three: arrival first, then kitchen, then departure. No jumping to the interesting bit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Is this about the cake? It was gone before I got there.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Put that under observations. I taught you to separate what happened from when you saw it. Now give me the times, starting with your arrival.
